In [[optimal control theory]], a '''transversality condition''' is a [[Boundary value problem|boundary condition]] for the terminal values of the [[costate equation|costate variables]]. They are one of the [[necessary condition]]s for optimality infinite-horizon [[optimal control]] problems without an endpoint [[Constraint (mathematics)|constraint]] on the [[state variable]]s.

* [[Pontryagin's maximum principle]]
